title: E で調べた物の文言
note: 目の向きのレイが最初に当たった当たり判定のノード（collision.glb の COL_…）の名前に一番長く合う prefix（名前そのものか「prefix_」で始まる）の text を画面の下に出す（行の並びは問わない）（字は英数字）。reach=調べられる距離（m）・showSeconds=出しておく秒・charsPerSecond=1 秒に出す字の数。扉の板を見て E を押すと扉を開け閉めする。

things.text: A red vending machine. Every button says SOLD OUT.
The white machine hums. One can sits in the tray, still cold.
Mailboxes. The one for 204 is stuffed with unopened letters.
Mailboxes. The one for 204 is stuffed with unopened letters.
A bicycle with flat tires. The lock has rusted shut.
Someone's bicycle. The seat is still wet.
An air conditioner. It drips, though nobody runs it.
A water heater. The pilot light flickers blue.
Recycling bins. Collection day was last week.
A bag hung on the doorknob. Nobody took it in.
Newspapers piled by the door. The dates stop in March.
A utility pole. Flyers for the same missing cat, layer on layer.
A family altar. The incense is still warm.
A kotatsu. It is switched on.
A futon, still pressed into the shape of someone.
A chair on its side. Nobody set it back up.
